meta.name: orca-cli
meta.description: Use the public `orca` CLI to operate Orca-managed worktrees, folder contexts, terminals, repos, automations, artifacts, skill sharing, worktree comments, and the browser embedded inside the Orca app. Use when the user says "$orca-cli", "use orca cli", "Orca worktree", "child worktree", "cardStatus", "spawn codex/claude in a worktree", "read/wait/send Orca terminal", "terminal send", "full handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", "another worktree", "Orca browser", "orca artifacts", "share HTML/Markdown", "public artifact link", "share skills", or "control the browser inside Orca". Prefer this over raw `git worktree`, ad hoc PTYs, Playwright, or Computer Use when the task touches Orca-managed state. Use Computer Use for browser windows, webviews, or desktop UI outside Orca's embedded browser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行操作开发工作区与终端
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常切换开发工作区并用终端执行操作。
copy.tagline_en: Manage dev worktrees and terminals from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often switch between dev worktrees and use terminal commands.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会改用公开的 orca CLI 操作 Orca 管理的工作树、终端、仓库、自动化、内置浏览器等；执行命令前先读取与当前版本匹配的完整指南，并优先用 --json 获取结果。
howto.when: 当用户提到 “$orca-cli”“Orca worktree”“full handoff” 等关键词，或要求操作 Orca 管理的工作树、终端、内置浏览器等状态时触发；不涉及 Orca 状态时改用普通 shell 工具。

say.text: 请用 orca CLI 显示当前工作树状态

howto.what_en: Claude uses the public `orca` CLI for Orca-managed worktrees, terminals, repos, automations, and the embedded browser. It loads the version-matched guide via `orca skills get orca-cli` before running commands and prefers `--json`.
howto.when_en: When the user says “$orca-cli”, “Orca worktree”, “full handoff”, etc., or asks to operate Orca-managed worktrees, terminals, or the embedded browser. Uses plain shell tools when Orca state is irrelevant.

say_en.text: Show the current worktree status with the orca CLI.
say_en.note: Claude resolves the orca binary and loads the full guide first.

say_en.text: Spawn codex in a child worktree and hand the task off fully.
say_en.note: Runs worktree spawn plus the full handoff flow.

say_en.text: Read recent Orca terminal output, then send exit.
